name: Shanghai International Airport Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai International Airport Co., Ltd. provides ground support services for domestic and foreign air transport companies and passengers in China. It offers long-distance passenger stations, parking lot management, and parking services, as well as freight forwarding, customs declaration, inspection, and other services.
